fusions.name: Lowered Tines
fusions.desc: Rushes you to a target up to 7 tiles away and gores it for 14 damage, rising to 1.3 times that at full reach. Its damage rises 5% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it (max 30%).

fusions.name: Alarm Drumming
fusions.desc: A shrill alarm and a stamped hoof hit every enemy within 2 tiles for 4 damage, with a 30% chance to leave each [Hindered] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Bound for the Treeline
fusions.desc: Increases your dodge chance by 20% for 10 seconds and bounds you 3 tiles from where you stood.

fusions.name: Startle Reflex
fusions.desc: Once every 8 seconds, a failed dodge is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.
